answer: Resist sybils by charging admission in locked stake, not headcount. A new identity may berth at the settlement wharf only after locking a jade bond for one full epoch; the bond is slashable if later clustering ties that key to an existing stake lineage. Before it can vote or grade, a reef of established peers must countersign, each from a distinct prior bond, so one operator cannot approve its own sockpuppets. Cloning then multiplies locked capital and required countersignatures linearly: a fake swarm cannot outvote honest agents without burning real spendable funds.
